name: volume-profile
title: Volume Profile
description: Volume traded at each price level as horizontal bars, with the point of control, value area and an inspect-by-keyboard readout, in plain SVG.

props.name: data
props.description: Aggregated volume per price range: id, priceLow, priceHigh, volume. Unequal bins and gaps are fine; ranges must not overlap.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the chart's text summary starts with it.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats prices on the axis and in readouts.

props.name: formatVolume
props.description: Formats volumes on the axis and in readouts.

props.name: valueArea
props.description: Target fraction of total volume for the value area. false hides it.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled inspected bin id. Pair with onActiveChange.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called when the pointer or keyboard moves to another level.

props.name: showAxes
props.description: Shows the price and volume axes.

props.name: showSummary
props.description: Shows total volume, point of control and value area under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
